from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
for name in ("models/STATE.json","models/CONTINUATION.json","models/BLOCKER.json"):
    p=base/name
    print("FILE",name,"EXISTS",p.is_file(),flush=True)
    if p.is_file():
        try:
            o=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for k in ("task_id","state","reason","attempt","checkpoint","next_action","retry_at","timestamp"):
                if k in o:
                    print(name,k,repr(o.get(k)),flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            print(name,"READ_ERROR",repr(e),flush=True)
result=base/"model_results"/(task+".json")
print("RESULT_EXISTS",result.is_file(),flush=True)
unit="prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.service"
p=subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","show",unit,
 "-p","ActiveState","-p","SubState","-p","Result","-p","ExecMainStatus","-p","ExecMainCode",
 "-p","ActiveEnterTimestamp","-p","InactiveEnterTimestamp"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print("SYSTEMCTL_SHOW_RC",p.returncode,flush=True)
print((p.stdout or "")[-6000:],flush=True)
j=subprocess.run(["journalctl","--user","-u",unit,"-n","120","--no-pager"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print("JOURNAL_RC",j.returncode,flush=True)
for line in (j.stdout or "").splitlines()[-120:]:
    if any(x in line for x in (task,"USAGE_LIMIT","PAUSED","checkpoint","attempt","retry_at","Started","Stopped","Failed")):
        print(line[:1800],flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
